newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen higher at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen higher at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to head higher at the start of trading on Wednesday, extending the bounce of the last three days.
Merger activity continues, with Procter & Gamble Co's announcing that it will buy Tambrands Inc for $50 per share, or $1.85 billion.

"I think we will have a fairly positive day," said Hildergard Zagorski, analyst at Prudential Securities. "We have had three up sessions, and bonds are steady. There is nothing to put a damper on today. There are no numbers coming out."
The Dow Jones industrial average ended up 53.25 points at 6,609.16 on Tuesday.
